import { Kafka } from "kafkajs";

const kafka = new Kafka({ clientId: "demo", brokers: ["broker:9092"] });

export async function publishOrder() {
  const producer = kafka.producer();
  await producer.connect();
  await producer.send({
    topic: "order.created",
    messages: [{ value: "v" }],
  });
}

export async function publishBatch() {
  const producer = kafka.producer();
  await producer.sendBatch({
    topicMessages: [
      { topic: "alpha.events", messages: [{ value: "a" }] },
      { topic: "beta.events", messages: [{ value: "b" }] },
    ],
  });
}

export async function subscribeOrders() {
  const consumer = kafka.consumer({ groupId: "audit" });
  await consumer.subscribe({ topic: "order.created", fromBeginning: true });
}

export async function subscribeMany() {
  const consumer = kafka.consumer({ groupId: "audit" });
  await consumer.subscribe({ topics: ["alpha.events", "beta.events"] });
}
